يبتسر (form VIII)
# يَبْتَسِرُ (yabtasiru) /jab.ta.si.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# يُبْتَسَرُ (yubtasaru) /jub.ta.sa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# يَبْتَسِرَ (yabtasira) /jab.ta.si.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# يُب
